items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 251:1
items.html: From the fifth hour of the eve of Shabbat and upward begins the sanctity of the addition of Shabbat, and the worlds begin to ascend. (Item 77).
